flags.name: --upstream
flags.description: The upstream MCP server's stdio command line. Must be the last option: every argument after it belongs to the upstream command.

environment.note: The upstream process inherits the gate's environment minus withheld_from_upstream. The gate is the MACP agent MACP_AGENT_ID; it initiates and commits every approval session.

exit_codes.2: Unusable configuration: bad MACP_* environment, an invalid gate.json, or a missing --upstream command. One line on stderr.

server.name: macp-mcp-gate
server.instructions: Some tools on this server are gated by MACP: a call to one opens a MACP session and runs only after the named approvers approve it. A refused call returns an error starting POLICY_DENIED or SESSION_NOT_OPEN; do not retry it unchanged.
